title: Iron Sand Maelstrom
body:
Syntax: perform iron sand maelstrom <target>

Description: A Magnet Release attack that strikes one target. Blindness reduces the target's accuracy.  Requires Magnet Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 1509-1789. 35% chance to inflict blinded. Unlocks at level 70. Costs 78 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 24 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
